script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" \
  --query kind=openhands.sdk.event.llm_convertible.message.MessageEvent \
  --check items len-eq 2 --check items.0.kind eq MessageEvent --check items.1.kind eq MessageEvent
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query kind=MessageEvent --expect 200 \
  --check items len-eq 2 --save F06.search-kind-short/short-name  # bug
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/count" --query kind=MessageEvent --check . eq 2  # bug
failed_command: control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/events/search" --query kind=MessageEvent --expect 200 --check items len-eq 2 --save F06.search-kind-short/short-name
